endpoints.summary: Run the full BoltzGen binder design pipeline.
endpoints.description:
Run the full BoltzGen binder design pipeline.

Requires a design specification YAML describing the target structure and
designed region. Reference CIF/PDB files referenced in the YAML should be
uploaded via `ref_files`, or bundled into a zip referenced by
`ref_files_zip_uri` (oss://, file://, job://, http(s)://) — the gateway
uses the zip form since it can't multipart-upload the `ref_files` list.

Pipeline: design -> inverse_folding -> folding -> [design_folding] ->
[affinity] -> analysis -> filtering.

request_fields.description: Output name prefix.

request_fields.name: protocol
request_fields.description: Design protocol — determines default settings for filtering/analysis.

request_fields.description: Number of final designs after diversity-quality filtering.

request_fields.name: diffusion_batch_size
request_fields.description: Diffusion samples per trunk run. None=auto (1 if num_designs<100, else 10).

request_fields.description: Fixed step scale (e.g. '1.8'). Default uses a schedule.

request_fields.name: noise_scale
request_fields.description: Fixed noise scale (e.g. '0.98'). Default uses a schedule.

request_fields.name: use_kernels
request_fields.description: cuequivariance kernel usage. 'auto' detects GPU capability >= 8.

request_fields.name: skip_inverse_folding
request_fields.description: Skip inverse folding step.

request_fields.name: inverse_fold_num_sequences
request_fields.description: Number of sequences per backbone in inverse fold step.

request_fields.name: inverse_fold_avoid
request_fields.description: Disallowed residues as one-letter AA codes (e.g. 'C' to avoid Cys). Default: 'C' for peptide/nanobody/antibody protocols, none for others.

request_fields.name: alpha
request_fields.description: Diversity/quality trade-off for filtering (0=quality-only, 1=diversity-only).

request_fields.name: filter_biased
request_fields.description: Remove amino-acid composition outliers.

request_fields.name: reuse
request_fields.description: Reuse existing results (resume interrupted pipeline).

request_fields.name: analysis_num_processes
request_fields.description: Parallel workers for the analysis step (upstream default 32; use 8-16 on nodes with ≤64 GB RAM to avoid OOM). None=upstream default.

examples.title: de novo protein binder design
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/design -F design_yaml=@design_spec.yaml -F ref_files=@target.cif -F protocol=protein-anything -F num_designs=100 -F budget=30
examples.notes: design_spec.yaml defines the target structure and designed region. ref_files should include all CIF/PDB files referenced by the YAML.

examples.title: nanobody CDR design
examples.curl: curl -X POST $URL/api/design -F design_yaml=@nanobody.yaml -F ref_files=@scaffold.cif -F protocol=nanobody-anything -F num_designs=50
examples.notes: Protocol auto-filters Cys in inverse fold step.

endpoints.summary: Run the full BoltzGen design pipeline as a single atomic task.
endpoints.description:
Run the full BoltzGen design pipeline as a single atomic task.

Blocks until pipeline completion.  Designed to be invoked via FC Async
Task Mode (X-Fc-Invocation-Type: Async): FC enqueues and dispatches,
the HTTP request stays active for the full subprocess lifetime so FC
won't recycle the instance mid-run.

For the legacy submit/poll interface, use POST /api/design instead.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

tool_outputs.design: output/final_ranked_designs/ — filtered CIF structures + metrics CSV. Also: output/**/aggregate_metrics_analyze.csv for all-design metrics.
tool_outputs.inverse_fold: output/final_ranked_designs/ — same structure as design, but starting from inverse folding of a provided backbone.
tool_outputs.note: Use GET /api/jobs/{id}/files to enumerate; download a single file via /api/jobs/{id}/file/{relpath} or zip the whole dir via /download.

protocols.peptide-anything: Peptide binder design (auto-filters Cys, stricter RMSD)
protocols.protein-small_molecule: Protein binder for small molecule (includes affinity prediction)

input_uri_schemes.design_yaml_uri: URI to the design spec YAML (instead of a `design_yaml` upload).
input_uri_schemes.ref_files_zip_uri: URI to a zip of the CIF/PDB files the YAML references, extracted flat next to the spec. Use this when `ref_files` can't be uploaded (e.g. via the gateway, which dispatches form fields only).
input_uri_schemes.job://<id>/<file>: Re-use a file from a prior job on the same NAS.
Generic URL, including OSS signed URLs.

config_tips.budget: final selection count after quality+diversity filtering; default 30
config_tips.protocol: auto-configures filtering/analysis settings per use case
config_tips.use_kernels: auto=detect GPU capability; set 'false' for older GPUs
config_tips.skip_inverse_folding: when design spec fully specifies sequences
config_tips.design_yaml: BoltzGen design spec YAML — see https://github.com/HannesStark/boltzgen/tree/main/example for format

service_specific.not_in_scope_v0_0_1: merge, per-step execution, multi-GPU, training, structured sequence input (use YAML directly)

post.description:
Stage a file on shared NAS and return a `file://` URI.

For inputs too large for the 128 KiB FC async event payload: upload the
bytes here over sync HTTP, then pass the returned `uri` as a `*_uri`
field on the real submit / async-task request. Because the file lands on
the shared NAS mount, any instance can resolve it later.

Extended health: surface whether NAS-mounted weights are reachable.

Weights live on NAS at `BOLTZGEN_WEIGHTS_DIR` + `BOLTZGEN_MOLDIR`
(default `/data/models/boltzgen/{weights,moldir}/`).  Reports missing
paths via `weights_missing` so the agent can detect a misconfigured FC
mount / unbound SIF without crashing the service.

Coarse classification of why a job failed.

Set by `finalize_job` based on subprocess return code + output detection,
or by `reload_from_disk` when a job was RUNNING at the moment of restart.
Lets the client distinguish recoverable from fatal failures without parsing
`error_summary` strings.
